content: <thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the molecule shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two doublets of 2 H each) and an aliphatic fragment consisting of 10 H at ~1.35 ppm (five CH₂ groups) and 1 H at ~2.63 ppm (a benzylic CH). This pattern matches a cyclohexyl group attached to a benzene ring that also bears a non‑proton substituent. A para‑chloro substituent gives the observed AA′BB′ aromatic pattern and accounts for the total of 15 H (4 aromatic + 11 aliphatic). The corresponding SMILES is **Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2**.
